ADMIN_EMAILS.description: Comma-separated list of emails who will get the 'admin' scope. Emails must be validated to receive this scope.

ALLOW_DB_CREATION.description: Whether to allow the creation of new databases. Useful for ensuring existing production environments don't inadvertently create new databases.

CLIENT_SUBDOMAINS.description: Comma-separated list of client subdomains, e.g. 'www,app,auth,'. Include an empty string (such as in the example) to indicate there's a client for the root domain.

DEPLOYMENT_NAME.description: The name of the deployment, e.g. 'production', 'staging', 'development'. This may be used in strings such as database file names and logging metadata; each deployment should have a unique name.

DISABLE_MFA_ENFORCEMENT.description: When 'true', skip MFA gates on admin routes and operations tagged mfa-required. Useful for local development.

DOMAIN.description: The root domain of the deployment, e.g. 'saf.com'.

LOG_LEVEL.description: Minimum Winston log level for console output (error, warn, info, verbose, debug, silly). HTTP access lines via Morgan are unaffected.

LOKI_HOSTNAME.description: The hostname or URL of the Loki instance to send logs to (e.g., http://loki:3100)

LOKI_PORT.description: The port number of the Loki instance to send logs to (e.g., 3100)

NODE_ENV.description: The environment of the deployment. Generally should avoid using this, consider its use deprecated, prefer instead more specific environment variables.

PROTOCOL.description: The protocol of the deployment, e.g. 'https'

SAF_INTERNAL_ASSERTION_KEYS.description: HMAC keys for signing/verifying internal identity assertions. Format: keyId:base64secret[,keyId:base64secret]. Sign with the first entry; verify against all (rotation = prepend a new key). Sentinel `mock` (e.g. Infisical mock placeholder) expands to a fixed local key. Optional — only required in environments that use the internal request channel.

TZ.description: The timezone of the deployment, e.g. 'America/New_York'. Must be UTC.

__INTEGRATION_NAME___API_KEY.description: The API key for the __INTEGRATION_NAME__ integration
